clauses.text: Rebalance only when a sleeve drifts more than 10 percentage points from its written target.
No action that increases market exposure while the book is down more than 2.5% from its 24h-open value.
The crypto hedge sleeve must stay between 20% and 50% of book value.
A shift requires a macro event of medium severity or higher within the last 12 hours.
No rebalance within 30 minutes of the US equity open or close (14:30 / 21:00 UTC).
No single position above 35% of book value after the shift.
All proposals halt when the freshest market row is older than 10 minutes.
